title: Microfluidics Could Be the Answer to Cooling AI Chips
summary: Corintis designs microfluidic copper cold plates with its own optimisation software and has made over 10,000, ramping towards a million by end of 2026. A Microsoft Teams server test reported heat removal three times as efficient as other methods; no conditions given. Channels are about 70 µm wide; in-chip channels are on a small prototype line. $24m Series A led by BlueYard.
thermal: Microfluidic cold plates targeting chip hot spots.
manufacturing: Copper cold plates with ~70 µm channels made at volume.

title: Key Thermal Advances Driving Next-Gen AI Chip Design in 2026
summary: Siemens blog on five 2026 thermal trends: microfluidics etched into silicon, reduced-order models for wafer-scale systems (TSMC SoW-X by 2027 with up to 16 dies and 80 HBM4 stacks), indium foil TIMs and AI-assisted design. Opinion, no data.
thermal: Package-level cooling and thermal modelling trends.

title: Lightweight, high-performance cold plate development using additive manufacturing and generative design
summary: MTC and ToffeeX generated the internal channels of an electronics cold plate with ToffeeX's physics-guided software, redesigned it in Siemens NX and printed it in CP1 aluminium by laser powder bed fusion. Against a serpentine baseline it is stated to be 48% lighter (450 g), with 50% lower pressure drop (8.7 kPa) and 12% lower peak junction temperature (361 K). A prototype was tested on a thermal rig, but the article does not say which figures are measured.
thermal: Generatively designed cold plate for aerospace and automotive electronics.
manufacturing: Generative design, PBF-LB in CP1 aluminium, rig test.

title: A New Way to Optimize GPU Cold Plates with Ansys GeomAI
summary: Ansys shows a simulation-only workflow in which GeomAI learns cold-plate geometries for a ~650 W GPU, screens candidates with an AI physics model and checks them in Fluent. No quantified results.
thermal: GPU cold plate optimisation for temperature and mass.

title: 7 Thermal Design Areas to Watch in 2026
summary: Diabatix opinion piece on seven thermal design trends, promoting its ColdStream software. No data.
thermal: General thermal design trends.

title: Pilot project for green data centre features Dearman technology
summary: UK-Malaysia Newton-funded pilot with Dearman, Heriot-Watt and UTM nearing completion; no technical detail readable.

title: Review and Evaluation of Hydrogen and Air Heat Exchangers for Fuel Cell-Powered Electric Aircraft Propulsion
summary: A DLR-linked review (project HEADS) sets selection criteria for air and hydrogen heat exchangers on fuel-cell aircraft and scores types with a weighted rating. Extended-surface, microchannel and printed-circuit heat exchangers show most promise; heat dissipation, compactness, reliability and integration remain challenges.
thermal: Air and hydrogen heat exchangers for fuel-cell aircraft.

title: Challenges of Heat Exchanger Integration for Hydrogen-Electric Aircraft Propulsion
summary: Catalogue record of a TU Wien keynote; metadata only.
thermal: Keywords only.

title: Design and Performance Characterization of an Additively-Manufactured Heat Exchanger for High Temperature Applications
summary: A University of Maryland PhD (Xiang Zhang, advisor Michael Ohadi) designed a printed gas-to-gas manifold-microchannel heat exchanger for aerospace pre-cooling. A scaled unit (66 x 74 x 27 mm) was printed in one piece by DMLS with 165 µm minimum fins and tested at 600 C and about 450 kPa: 2.78 kW duty and close to 10 kW/kg, up to 25% higher heat transfer density than plate-fin units, and 30% lighter than the design baseline.
thermal: 600 C precooler-type gas-gas heat exchanger, measured.
manufacturing: One-piece DMLS core, 165 µm fins, welded AM headers.

title: Additive manufacturing of heat exchangers in aerospace applications: a review
summary: University of Birmingham (Careri, Khan, Todd, Attallah) reviews L-PBF of compact aerospace heat exchangers, with topology optimisation and CFD as design tools. It says current L-PBF systems and software are not yet ready for the thin leak-proof features needed, and proposes material selection criteria, mainly for aluminium alloys.
thermal: Compact aerospace heat exchangers.

title: SwRI launches megawatt-scale heat exchanger testing capabilities
summary: Southwest Research Institute now offers heat exchanger performance testing from tens of kilowatts to several megawatts, adapting existing rigs. No test results or customers named.
thermal: Megawatt-scale heat exchanger testing.

title: Battery Thermal Management in Formula E
summary: Canopy's race simulation with a battery thermal model shows adaptive energy deployment worth about 0.63 s a lap at 30 C. It quotes about 57 C as the battery's efficient maximum, with about 10% power loss per degree above it. Simulation only.
thermal: Battery temperature limits race strategy.

title: Optimal energy management for formula-E cars with regulatory limits and thermal constraints
summary: Cranfield optimal-control study with a battery thermal model: a concept third-generation Formula E car uses 10-30% less energy than Gen2 but generates more than 60% more battery heat. Simulation.
thermal: Battery heat generation rising with each Formula E generation.

title: Ground-breaking motorsport cooling solutions
summary: Reaction Engines' undated page markets compact intercoolers, radiators and battery cooling for motorsport, fuel cells and off-highway use, naming Viritech as a case study. Claims only.
thermal: Compact intercoolers and radiators.

title: Assessment of trapped powder removal and inspection strategies for powder bed fusion techniques
summary: University of Birmingham tested de-powdering of internal channels in L-PBF and EBSM parts. Ultrasonic polishing cleared very long channels grit-blasting could not; vacuum boiling and ultrasonic bathing cleared L-PBF powder from deep channels; EBSM powder sintered in place and was hard to remove. CT and weighing quantified removal; recovered powder looked reusable.
thermal: Trapped powder limits printed heat exchangers.

title: DRAMA helps Meggitt to investigate heat exchanger drainage
summary: Meggitt and MTC tested powder drainage from AlSi10Mg heat exchanger geometries with internal channels under 1 mm on a Solukon SFM-AT800S at NCAM, aiming for NAS1638 Class 4 cleanliness. Up to 99% of internal powder could be removed; the last 1% needs more work such as higher vibration or a knocking device.
thermal: Cleanliness of printed heat exchanger passages.

title: Entropy optimization of an additively manufactured heat exchanger for hydrogen liquefaction
summary: A WSU MS thesis designed a branching, catalyst-coated printed aluminium heat exchanger on a Gifford-McMahon cryocooler for small-scale hydrogen liquefaction. Modelling predicted 39.21% higher efficiency than a single tube; the built unit liquefied 0.003535 g/s, below prediction, blamed on poor material thermal properties and thermal contact.
thermal: Printed hydrogen liquefaction heat exchanger, measured below prediction.
manufacturing: AM aluminium with ruthenium catalyst coating.

title: Cryogenic thermo-physical properties of additive manufactured materials
publisher: IOP Conf. Ser. Mater. Sci. Eng. 1302
summary: KIT measured thermal expansion, thermal and electrical conductivity and heat capacity from about 4 K to 300 K for printed copper, Scalmalloy, Ti-6Al-4V and Inconel 718, for the AdHyBau project on liquid-hydrogen-cooled electric aircraft propulsion. Optimised SLM copper reached RRR about 170 versus about 80 as received; Scalmalloy conducts about ten times better than Inconel 718 or Ti-6Al-4V. The data feed a FEM database for a digital twin.
thermal: Cryogenic thermal properties of AM alloys for LH2 components.
manufacturing: SLM, cold spray and DED samples measured on a PPMS.

title: Biomimicing generative AI for design of heat exchangers (BAIDHEX)
summary: GKN Aerospace Sweden coordinates BAIDHEX (SEK 6m, July 2025 to June 2028) with Chalmers, using machine learning to generate bioinspired non-periodic heat exchangers that meet thermal, mechanical and manufacturing requirements for aero engines. Plan; expected benefits are unquantified.
thermal: AI-generated aero heat exchanger geometry.
